newsitem.title: GREECE: Goal of stable ecu/drs met in 96 - Bank of Greece.
newsitem.headline: Goal of stable ecu/drs met in 96 - Bank of Greece.

text.p: The Greek monetary policy's intermediate goal of keeping the drachma broadly stable against the ecu was accomplished in 1996, the Bank of Greece said in a statement.
The drachma slid 1.0 percent year-on-year versus the ecu on December 31, 1996, it said.
Ecu/drachma stood at 306.830 on December 31 as opposed to 303.760 on December 29, 1995 and 294.780 on December 30, 1994 and 278.200 on December 31, 1993.
On average yearly levels, the drachma was down 0.5 percent against the ecu in 1996 compared to 1995.
The average ecu/drachma rate was 301.026 in 1996 compared to 299.538 in 1995 and 287.183 in 1994, it said.

The effective drachma exchange rate, a weighted average of the drachma against major foreign currencies, was up 0.41 percent year-on-year on December 31, 1996 but down 1.14 percent on average yearly levels in 1996 compared to 1995, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
